stem.text: An aqueous solution was prepared containing a mixture of $1.0\text{ mol}$ of $\text{AgNO}_3$ and $1.0\text{ mol}$ of $\text{FeSO}_4$ in $1.00\text{ dm}^{3}$ of water. When equilibrium was established, there was $0.44\text{ mol}$ of $\text{Ag}^{+}\text{(aq)}$ in the mixture.
What is the numerical value of $K_\text{c}$?
